GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

2. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   B. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

5. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   B. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   D. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   B. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

10. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.

11. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

12. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   C. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.

13. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   C. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Treat Energy as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
